selection.name: Inspect AI (C08)
selection.role: Semantic and agent evaluation with auditable scoring. Preserve unresolved judgments explicitly and report scored, unscored and errored cases separately.

basis.shows: Documented installation, datasets with target labels, local model providers and external agent evaluation. Supports independently supplied labels; their independence must come from the evaluation design.

Distinguishes scores, scoring errors and Score.unscored(reason). Unresolved judgments retain explanations. Errors and unscored cases can be excluded from accuracy denominators, so coverage must accompany accuracy.
Original errors that trigger sample retries remain in error_retries. This directly fits failure-preserving evidence.
Documents bridging external agents, including Claude Code and Codex CLI.
API-observed Python 3.10 and 3.11 test jobs succeeded at the reviewed head; slow tests were skipped. Framework CI establishes tested implementation, not semantic-advice accuracy.
Latest documented version 0.3.275 is dated 2026-10-01; reviewed default-branch commit is dated 2026-10-02 UTC. Repository is unarchived.
Recent issue activity: updated 2026-10-02 UTC. Update recency does not establish maintainer responsiveness.

selection.name: Playwright (C05)
selection.role: Independent browser observations and behavioral assertions. Capture the initial attempt with tracing enabled and retain failed, flaky and skipped outcomes.

basis.shows: Documents installation, isolated browser testing and reports. Explicit platform requirements include WSL and supported Debian/Ubuntu on x86_64 or arm64, plus macOS 14+.
Documents npx playwright test --trace on. Default on-first-retry tracing misses the original attempt; enabling tracing from the first run is necessary for this requirement.
Native Claude and Codex agent initialization is documented. The healer can skip broken functionality, so its resulting status must not replace review of the original failure.
All 13 API-returned browser/OS matrix jobs succeeded, including Ubuntu and macOS. No comparative regression-detection superiority follows from these results.
Release published 2026-09-04, within 90 days. Reviewed default-branch commit b630e71 is dated 2026-10-01; repository is unarchived.

selection.name: Harbor (containerized agent E2E runner) (C04)
selection.role: Repeatable full-agent trials with executable project verifiers and structured failure artifacts. Inspect trial results explicitly rather than relying solely on the runner's process exit.
selection.install_source: Upstream README.md at bf991e490394ef9c3250a6db2bc5cbda903cb4c3; Python >=3.12 and Docker are needed for the documented local benchmark path.

basis.shows: Documents installation, custom benchmarks, Claude Code/Codex evaluation and local Docker execution. Its official Terminal-Bench 2.0 harness role establishes intended use, not measured superiority.

Supports separate verifier environments, artifact transfer, structured results and first-exception traceback preservation. Ordinary exceptions become returned trial results; log-download errors can be logged without propagation.
API-observed Ubuntu and Windows test jobs succeeded. Linux execution is evidenced; exact WSL2 and macOS arm64 compatibility remains untested.
The reviewed type-check job was CANCELLED. The inspected CI record is not uniformly passing.
Release published 2026-09-12, within 90 days. Reviewed default-branch commit bf991e4 is dated 2026-10-01; repository is unarchived.

layers.deciding_comparison: The set is selected on documented complementary capability, not measured superiority. Compare Inspect AI and Promptfoo on the WSL2 host using identical model/scorer settings, fresh independently labeled semantic-advice cases and a safe benign negative control. Freeze labels before running; retain uncertain disagreements, errors and original attempts; do not tune on the existing eight-case diagnostic. Measure label agreement, control false alarms, scored/error/unscored coverage, repeatability and evidence survival after retry/rescoring. Separately seed relevant project/browser regressions to check Playwright and Harbor's false passes and artifact retention.
evidence_gaps: The required ctx_fetch_and_index workflow was blocked with 'MCP tool call requires approval, but approval policy is never'. Eight page fetches were attempted, none succeeded, and no pages were read through ctx_search. Documentation was instead verified through GitHub API source reads; the requested page-review workflow remains incomplete.
Budget used: six web search queries and 30 GitHub API calls—20 repository/commit requests, seven README requests and three batched GraphQL requests. Search excerpts were treated only as leads.

The packet records no comparison where all named arms ran. No verified benchmark or paper separates the candidates on fresh semantic-advice cases; passing framework CI does not establish that superiority.

No clean install or target-host execution was performed. Playwright explicitly documents WSL support; exact macOS arm64 execution for the selected set and Harbor's task-image compatibility require validation.
The harnesses themselves do not require the RTX 4090. Fit of any chosen local evaluation model within 24 GB VRAM was not measured.
Inspect excludes some unresolved/error cases from accuracy denominators. Preserve individual outcomes and report coverage; returning None can omit an explicit unscored count.
Harbor's complete verifier-log retention and CLI failure exit semantics were not verified. Its reviewed type check was cancelled.
CI and source observations concern reviewed default-branch commits; they do not certify every feature in the separately documented release artifacts.
Recent issue updates establish activity, not response quality. No mandatory paid-service exclusion was justified for any candidate.
